node.title: Re: WebSocket idle
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I'm not sure because you haven't shown any code, but it sounds to me like you might be using a blocking [doc://sleep] call or something like it? Just a thought: have you considered using non-blocking I/O in an event loop? I've successfully used [http://poe.perl.org|POE] several times now, it has a little bit of a learning curve but if you get into it, it's pretty useful. Its Cookbook even includes an example Websocket client.
